meta.siteTitle: Cover Studio · Free open-source app cover generator
meta.siteDescription: Generate a pro cover for your app, README or LinkedIn from your screenshots. Free, open source, no account, 100% in your browser.
meta.keywords: cover generator, app cover, app mockup, screenshot, README, Open Graph, open source, free
meta.ogImageAlt: Cover Studio: generate a pro cover for your app
meta.appFeatures: Automatic layout from a screenshot, 5 templates, brand color derived from your interface, PNG export in several formats (optional 2× resolution), no data upload

landing.heroTitle: A pro cover for your app, built from your screenshots
landing.heroText: Import a screenshot of your app: the layout, mockups and colors are generated for you. All that's left is to write the text.
landing.startText: Desktop or mobile, up to 4 screenshots. Add your logo and pick the brand color, or let it come from your first screenshot.
landing.step1Text: Then add more and choose their order in the editor.
landing.step2Text: Name, description, features and brand color.
landing.step3Text: A PNG ready for your README, portfolio, LinkedIn or social networks, in the size of your choice.
landing.githubAria: View the source code on GitHub (opens in a new tab)
landing.openSourceText: Cover Studio is released under the MIT license. The code is public: read it, self-host it, improve it.
landing.osFreeText: No account, no watermark, no export quota.
landing.osPrivateText: Everything is generated in your browser: your screenshots never leave your device.
landing.osContribText: New templates, translations, fixes: pull requests are welcome.
landing.pickHint: Click a template to start from it in the editor.
landing.pickedHint: Selected template: {name}. Click it again to cancel.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. It is an open-source project under the MIT license: no account, no watermark and no export limit.
faq.q2: Are my screenshots sent to a server?
faq.a2: No. Import, layout and PNG export all happen in your browser. No image is ever uploaded.
faq.a3: PNG files: 2400 × 1500 for a cover, or Open Graph, GitHub, X / Twitter, Product Hunt and square formats, with an optional 2× high-resolution mode.
faq.q4: Can I self-host it or contribute?
faq.a4: Yes. The site is fully static: clone the GitHub repository, run the build and host the generated folder anywhere. Contributions are welcome.
